ft: A ft is a linear unit of length equal to 12 inches or a third of a yard.
For example: "He is six feet tall."
Ft means the same as foot.
ft-l: A ft-L is a former luminance unit equal to one lumen per square foot.
Ft-L means the same as foot-lambert.
ftc: FTC is an independent agency of the United States federal government that maintains fair and free competition.
FTC means the same as Federal Trade Commission.
fthm: A fthm is a linear unit of measurement for water depth.
Fthm can also mean a unit of volume used in measuring bodies of ore.
Fthm means the same as fathom.
fto: FTO is a political movement that uses terror as a weapon to achieve its goals.
FTO means the same as terrorist organization or terrorist group or foreign terrorist organization.
ftp: FTP is protocol that allows users to copy files between their local system and any system they can reach on the network.
FTP can also mean use the file transfer protocol to transfer data from one computer to another.
FTP means the same as file transfer protocol.
